correctness.evidence: Independent word generation, factor-span construction, exact minimum hitting-set optimization for all 12 n<=64 instances, and witness cover checks reproduce the claimed minima and factor totals.

originality.evidence: Schaeffer–Shallit and Kempa–Prezza cover the framework and other sequences, but no matching RS/PF finite exact minima+witness inventory was identified. Novelty is limited to this finite table and certificates.

scientific_value.evidence: The exact instances provide reusable benchmark data for string-attractor solvers and automatic-sequence compression experiments.

decision: Validated on all three axes as a finite exact benchmark; no infinite asymptotic classification is claimed.
